title: Prison of Souls
description: A dark hooded figure kneels in a stone dungeon, one hand pressed against the wall as ghostly translucent faces and hands emerge from behind heavy iron prison bars. Ethereal white and purple smoke-like spirits swirl upward toward a barred window, while multiple pale hands reach up from the floor.
prompt: A solitary hooded figure in a dark coat kneels inside a decrepit stone dungeon prison, hand pressed to the wall, surrounded by multiple ghostly pale faces and hands emerging from behind heavy iron bars.
